summary: First full test run for Prva smena PWA. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (sync LWW, admin login/auth, admin data gating, empty payload). Frontend: full happy-path verified on mobile viewport (430x900) — home save increments DOŠLO, auto time editable, unknown garage hint + auto-add on save, totalizers compute diff/total and persist after reload, Vozila search shows history, add vehicle dialog works and rejects duplicate, edit fueling works, Izveštaj shows arrivals count, pump stats and top pump, QF signature checkbox toggles & persists after reload, 3 PDFs (weekly, QF, period) each trigger a download event, admin login rejects wrong pw, accepts 'puzopb', shows panel with day rows and logs out. Sync badge shows 'Sinhronizovano' after save and data confirmed on backend via /api/admin/data.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing Description/aria-describedby — accessibility warning in console. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to each DialogContent.

Recharts ResponsiveContainer warns 'width(-1) and height(-1)...' repeatedly — set an explicit minWidth/minHeight or aspect on the chart container to silence warnings and avoid first-render layout jank.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to all Radix DialogContent usages to fix a11y warnings.
(Nice-to-have) Give Recharts ResponsiveContainer explicit minHeight (e.g., minHeight={160}) to remove width/height -1 warnings on Izveštaj.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: upsert_lww compares updated_at strings lexicographically — works only because ISO-8601 UTC is used. Consider parsing to datetime for safety if clients send differing timezones.
server.py: /api/sync has no auth and no size limit — anyone can push data to the public endpoint. For a single-device app this may be acceptable, but consider rate-limit or shared device token.
Admin token is deterministic (HMAC of fixed password with fixed secret), so it never rotates. Any leak is permanent until ADMIN_SECRET rotates. Minor given scope.
Startup uses deprecated @app.on_event; migrate to lifespan handler for future FastAPI compat.
Totalizers.jsx useEffect dependency array disables exhaustive-deps for saved.updated_at — intentional but comment-worthy.
seed_data_creation: pytest created a few TEST_* fuelings/vehicles and a totalizer with id tot_<today> in MongoDB. Minimal and clearly prefixed; safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest). UI happy-path flow validated end-to-end on 430x900 viewport. Known non-blocking warnings: Radix Dialog a11y description missing, Recharts container size warnings. 276 seeded vehicles present (verified via Vozila list render).
rca of the issue: No bugs reproduced — all requested flows pass.
